result:
I would make understanding automatic.

Not telepathy, exactly. More like: if someone is hurting, in danger, lying, or afraid, others would feel the weight of it before they act. Not enough to end conflict, but enough to make cruelty harder.

The world already has enough power to destroy itself. What it lacks is the constant, felt knowledge of consequence.
